thread:
jen: hi everyone! quick pre-note: if my audio cuts out it's because im trying to whisper to my dog under the desk. say hi to new hires in the chat! :wave:

ryan: hello hello!! welcome!! :tada: :tada:

maya: waved vigorously. also brought virtual donuts. imagine powdered sugar. :doughnut:

liam: actual donuts or office-ghost donuts? need to know if i should sprint to kitchen. :runner:

tina: office-ghost donuts this time. they appear, then vanish. spooky morale boost. :ghost::cookie:

ops-bot: Poll created 85 - "Post-all-hands tradition?" Options: Group selfie, Snack huddle, Quick quiz. Vote with /vote <option>. (Poll ID 4421)

ryan: /vote Snack huddle

maya: /vote Group selfie (bring your funky socks)

jen: shoutout: huge thanks to infra for that midnight failover fix. tiny applause pls. :clap:

liam: :clap::clap: and a virtual high five. also can we get an oncall hero sticker? tiny stickers pls.

dev-bot: Congrats to infra (deploy #978) oncall: @liam for successful rollback handling. Badge awarded.

tina: someone GIF the rollback as a dramatic movie scene pls.

sara: posted GIF: https://media.giphy.com/media/3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA/giphy.gif (reactions: :rofl:)

ryan: logistics: recording will be up; captions enabled. link in 10.

ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.co/all-hands/1851239999.mp4 (captions available)

maya: sidenote: the mic made a weird kazoo noise during Q&A. 10/10 entertainment value.

jen: that was intentional kazoo segment. policy update: kazoo is an approved reaction sound. :kazzoo: (not a real emoji)

liam: one last important thing who ate my labelled muffin from the table? it had my name. very specific sad muffin.

ryan: saw crumbs near the plants, investigate report filed. :mag:

tina: confession: may have nibbled one corner. left a polite note. sorry liam!!! :grimacing:

liam: all good. accept the note and offer of one replacement muffin (gluten-free).

jen: thanks everyone. extra thanks to new hires for the energy. end of non-technical banter, back to the agenda. :coffee:

ryan: quick poll add: should next all-hands have a 2-min cheesy talent show? react with :performing_arts: if yes.

sara: posted emoji reaction: :performing_arts:
